author: pjmagee
name: OpenClawRpc
short: RPC bridge so an OpenClaw agent can control Red (status, voice, audio).
description: Registers official Red RPC handlers so OpenClaw agents can control Red without Discord command impersonation. Intended for explicit user requests only.
install_msg: Loaded OpenClawRpc. Ensure Red is started with --rpc and a loopback forwarder if calling from another container.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users.
